reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A8AD0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A8AD0-Camera_UpdateTransform_15.cpp at sha256 19c61eb19bf9108e20c1c35d8a63462156b12382ca6725a54d8dd06e657e4fad (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t __fastcall Camera_UpdateTransform_15(int32_t param_1, void* param_2, void* param_3, long param_4);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t __fastcall(int32_t arg1, void* arg2, void* arg3 @ ebp, long double arg4 @ st0)" at 0x004A8AD0; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a8ad0 ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A8AD0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t __fastcall Camera_UpdateTransform_15(int32_t param_1, void* param_2, void* param_3, long param_4);.
